verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy axis for an AI SaaS notebook, so it applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers model training, data-use policies, or an opt-out control. The Workspace core-service mention does not say whether user data is used for training, so it earns no credit.
